comment: The published build: src/ and bin/, nothing else. `files` ships all of dist, so anything compiled here is on npm -- and a single reach into tests/ put the fixture server there (dist/tests/server.js shipped until 2026-09-23). Three files made that edge: the measurement harness, which now lives in tools/, and `scripts/demo.ts` and `scripts/record-race.ts`, which are developer tools run through tsx and had no reason to be compiled at all (nothing has ever read dist/scripts). Repo tooling is typechecked by tsconfig.test.json instead, which is what keeps it honest now that the build does not look at it.
